model_annotation: The plot illustrates the representation of a value, labeled BLEU, against a value labeled Average Lagging (AL). The x-axis is linear, ranging from 2.5 to 10.0, with tick labels at 2.5, 5.0, 7.5, and 10.0. The y-axis is linear, ranging from 25 to 32, with tick labels at 25, 26, 27, 28, 29, 30, 31, and 32.  A purple dashed line with square markers, labeled "Consistency-CE," begins at approximately 26.3 at x=2.5 and increases to approximately 31.3 at x=10.0. A blue dashed line with square markers, labeled "Inconsistency-CE," begins at approximately 26.1 at x=2.5 and increases to approximately 31.2 at x=10.0. A red solid line with star markers, labeled "Consistency-Bi," begins at approximately 29.0 at x=2.5 and increases to approximately 32.2 at x=10.0.
